headline: Jensen Huang says he would be honored to return as Nvidia chief executive
summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expressed willingness to return to the semiconductor maker if requested by the board. Huang resigned last week following reports of undisclosed workplace relationships.
why: Nvidia is the world's leading designer of artificial intelligence chips and one of the largest technology companies by market capitalization.

impacts.name: Nvidia Corporation
impacts.why: Executive leadership turmoil and potential CEO reinstatement directly impact investor confidence and governance.
